blocks.prompt: 5 To do a piece of work, Abdullah takes 10 days more than Abdul Hadi. Together they finish the work in 12 days. How long would Abdul Hadi take to finish it alone?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh time and work (waqt aur kaam) ka word problem hai. Bunyadi usool: jo shakhs kaam \(n\) din mein karta hai, woh ek din mein kaam ka \(\frac{1}{n}\) hissa karta hai.
Diya kya hai? Abdullah, Abdul Hadi se 10 din zyada leta hai; dono mil kar 12 din mein kaam khatam karte hain.
Find kya karna hai? Abdul Hadi akela kitne din lega.
Plan: Abdul Hadi ke din \(x\) maan kar dono ka ek din ka kaam jama karenge aur \(\frac{1}{12}\) ke barabar rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Abdullah ke din = Abdul Hadi ke din + 10; mil kar 12 din.
Humein find karna hai: Abdul Hadi ka akele waqt.
Tareeqa: Din seedhe jama nahi hote (12 din ka matlab yeh nahi ke \(x + (x + 10) = 12\)). Jama hamesha "ek din ka kaam" hota hai. Misaal: ek nal tanki 2 ghante mein bharta hai, to ek ghante mein aadhi tanki.

Unknown chunein
\[\text{Abdul Hadi: } x \text{ days}\]
\[\text{Abdullah: } x + 10 \text{ days}\]
Kyun: Sawal kehta hai Abdullah 10 din zyada leta hai, to us ke din \(x + 10\).

Equation banayen
\[\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{1}{x + 10} = \dfrac{1}{12}\]
Kyun: Ek din mein Abdul Hadi \(\frac{1}{x}\) kaam karta hai aur Abdullah \(\frac{1}{x + 10}\). Mil kar woh ek din mein \(\frac{1}{12}\) kaam karte hain, kyunke poora kaam 12 din mein hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(x + x + 10 = 12\) likhna sab se aam ghalti hai; days nahi, rates jama hote hain.

Fractions khatam karein
\[12(x + 10) + 12x = x(x + 10)\]
\[24x + 120 = x^2 + 10x\]
Kyun: LCD \(12x(x + 10)\) se har term multiply ki. Pehli fraction mein \(x\) cancel, doosri mein \((x + 10)\) cancel, aur right par 12 cancel ho gaya.

Standard form aur factorization
\[x^2 - 14x - 120 = 0\]
\[(x - 20)(x + 6) = 0\]
\[x = 20 \text{ or } x = -6\]
Kyun: Sab ek taraf: \(10x - 24x = -14x\). Product \(-120\) aur sum \(-14\) wale numbers \(-20\) aur \(6\). Din negative nahi ho sakte, to \(x = 20\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{1}{20} + \dfrac{1}{30} = \dfrac{3}{60} + \dfrac{2}{60}\]
\[= \dfrac{5}{60} = \dfrac{1}{12} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Abdullah \(20 + 10 = 30\) din leta hai. Dono ka ek din ka kaam \(\frac{1}{12}\) banta hai, yani poora kaam 12 din mein. Sawal ki shart poori hai.
blocks.final_answer: Abdul Hadi akela 20 din lega (Abdullah 30 din).
